headline: Stealth's Space-Bunny Hits 20.9%, Reshuffles the Entire Board
summary: stealth/space-bunny-alpha just claimed the top spot with a record-breaking 20.9% token share, a 2.8-point jump in a single day. DeepSeek holds second at 22.4% but is now in the crosshairs. Three new models entered the rankings, three older ones dropped out, and the top five providers now command 70.1% of the market.
highlights: stealth/space-bunny-alpha hits all-time high of 20.9% token share—day 1 of what could be a serious run
DeepSeek still leads at 22.4%, but stealth's surge is the biggest single-day move in the dataset
Top two providers (DeepSeek + stealth) now hold 43.2% combined
Zhipu AI dropped 9.4 points over the week; Tencent fell 6.1 points
Xiaomi surged 2.1 points week-over-week, climbing from rank 26 to rank 5
